name: robots/jbakams__slimebot-volleyball
title: Slimebot Volleyball 1-vs-1 (Gym simulation)
intro: Slimebot Volleyball 1-vs-1 (Gym simulation), adapted from jbakams/slimebot-volleyball. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
